comment: A copy of yantrik-mind's deploy/private_ranges.json (E.NET1b, at 55842db): the private and special-use ranges a mind may never reach except by a person's rule that says lan. Read by yantrik-egress (src/ranges.rs, include_str!). Keep v4 and v6 identical to the twin; change both or neither. An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (::ffff:0:0/96) is judged by its embedded IPv4.
